product_metadata.title: Woven Tufted Boho Throw Pillow Cover Set of 2, Modern Decorative Geometric Diamond Chevron Cushion with Tassels, Farmhouse Tribal Pillowcase for Couch Sofa Bedroom Living Room, 18 x 18 Inches, Ivory
features: SIZE & FABRIC - NO INSERTS, 18 x 18 inches pack of 2, boho throw pillow cover only. Select 100% premium cotton canvas tufted with designed ivory geometric chevron diamond pattern in the facade. Decorated with hand knotted fringe tassels.

TRENDY & UNIQUE DESIGN - Farmhouse decorative pillowcase design highlighted by tufting & thick tassel embellishments in neutral ivory & white & cream tones, will stands out in the mix. A textile fabric with an interesting chevron symmetrical and diamond design perfect for decorating homes with rustic or bohemian décor, offer the enhanced touch to any room.Tufting also brings a cozy feeling to your home.

EXQUISITE CRAFT: These modern minimalist throw pillow come with premium quality hidden zipper for an elegant look and easily insert the pillows. The production process pays great attention to detail, ensuring that each seam of the pillowcase is strong and not easily damaged. Tight zigzag over-lock stitches to avoid fraying and ripping. Fantastic quality will absolutely exceed your expectations.

MULTIPLE USAGES: The set of 2 neutral contemporary style absolutely adorable and nice decorative pillow cover can be enjoyed by almost everyone. These sofa cushion pillow covers are not just beautiful decorations for your room, office, car, but delicate gift for your friends, neighbors, parents. Thick fabric really supports your back well. The perfect boho looks pillow cover is as equally pleasing to the touch as it's to the eye.

GUARANTEE - We stand by the quality of our bedding & linens. We’re sure that you’ll love our pillow cases, but if in the case that you’re not, you’re covered by our 30-day money back guarantee. We promise 100% customer satisfaction.
description: Snugtown is a young brand engaged in design & manufacture of home decoration. We devote to provide products with excellent quality and reasonable price.
We provide strong after-sales service, you can enjoy 100% money back guarantee and replacement warranty.
It applies to sofa, living room, couch, office,dining room, coffee shop and car. You will get a lot of compliments on these pillow cases.
Includes: 2 PCS pillow case, NO PILLOW INSERT/FILLER
Care Instruction: Machine wash cold separately on a gentle cycle(no bleach).The first cleaning may have some floating fiber, please understand this is a normal phenomenon.
